package.name: autoware_core_scenario_launch
package.description:
The autoware_core profile launcher: the launch file concealer forks for architecture_type:=awf/core. Brings up map, sensing, localization, perception, planning, control, vehicle and API from autoware_core's own launch files, plus the AD API operation-mode node and the component evaluator.
Its job is to absorb the argument set the simulator pushes and to make each component group optional, so that P0/P2/P3 profiles differ by argument rather than by a forked launch file.
